description: Training structure, source-default configuration alignment, coverage and matched Optax performance regression

native_defaults.comparison: All model/pipeline/optimization/densify defaults; scene/output paths are CLI arguments; JAX runtime settings separate

coverage_scope: All src/jaxgs Python, including CuTe bindings. Only compiled bodies decorated @cute.kernel, @cute.jit or @dsl_user_op excluded in BOTH baseline and result; GPU execution checked by numerical tests, not Python tracing.

fixed_count.scope: 3 interleaved runs, same 975104-point PLY, one view, 10 warmup + 200 timed updates; identical 10k LR settings, Optax, nnx.jit donation

full_training.scope: One run per version, 9971 updates, same images_4/split/seed/1M capacity/8M pairs, all growth/reset/refinement included; excludes preload, compile and save. New defaults deliberately not used for this comparison.
